messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "patient is assessed frequently"
set: ["patient is assessed frequently", "Patient", "specific patient populations", "each injection is pre-filled and intended for use by one patient only", "older adults may take less frequently than younger adults", "1 fewer patient 25 to 64", "multi-dose KwikPen (for single patient use)", "caregiver can call doctor if patient is unable to seek treatment on their own", "dosage should be adjusted according to patient response", "intravenous therapy should be discontinued as soon as the patient is able to resume oral therapy", "is normal", "duration should be consistent with individual patient treatment goals", "not assessed whether it still works as an anti-anxiety medicine beyond four months", "read medication guide or patient instructions provided with each medication", "read all patient information, medication guides, and instruction sheets provided", "risk is high when the dose is changed"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
